interface.longDescription: An independent MIT-licensed adaptation of Lauren Tan's pstack. Includes 54 skills, 24 engineering principles, and 23 playbooks for planning, architecture, implementation, code review, testing, technical writing, and verification. Workflows use the tools and permissions available in the current execution environment. Optional helpers have explicit dependency setup. Requires local execution. Supported environments and limitations are documented in the repository.
defaultPrompt: Use $pstack-codex:poteto-mode to plan and verify this change.

release_notes: Initial release of the independent Codex adaptation of Lauren Tan's pstack. Includes 54 skills, 24 engineering principles, 23 playbooks, separate host adapters, the glass-potato logo, and the original MIT attribution. Preferences remain outside the shared package.
